before-the-fremennik-trials.speaker: Sigmund the Merchant
before-the-fremennik-trials.text: Hello outerlander. By the laws of our tribe, I am afraid I may not speak to you without the express permission of the chieftain.

after-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Greetings again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! What can I do for you this day?

steps.npc: Well, feel free to stop by anytime that you wish [Fremennik name]. You are always welcome here!
